changes.reason: The outbox adapter forwards the relay signal to the existing EventBus publish options so a waiting delivery can be cancelled.

kubernetes.reason: The Kubernetes Node Host is outside the publish callback. The relay forwards an existing AbortSignal through the EventBus contract without requiring a host capability, storage change, or new shutdown hook.
constraints: Cancellation of a pending delivery depends on the configured EventBus honoring the signal. The in-memory implementation cancels capacity waits and allows active handlers to finish.
